title: ECP Case Amendment (versioned case correction, M3-CA0-A)
description: The case versioning / repair record (M3-CA0-A §7). A case amendment is a VERSIONED, hash-chained correction of a documented authoring defect in a candidate case. The original candidate version is immutable; the amendment record is the only legitimate representation of the change. The record is built in TWO SEPARATE STEPS: (1) DRAFTING (the amendment content is authored; the representation-bias disclosure MUST NOT be completed concurrently) and (2) DISCLOSURE (completed afterwards, in a separate step, against the fully-formed draft — machine-evidenced by draft_hash, which covers the disclosure-free draft, and amendment_hash, which covers the completed record). representation_bias_disclosure is an AUDIT/PROVENANCE field, never an eligibility decision by itself; a value of POSSIBLE or KNOWN must never be silently treated as unbiased (it remains traceable in every review artifact that applies the amendment). draft_hash = SHA-256 over ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 of this document with draft_hash removed, representation_bias_disclosure removed and disclosure_phase.status set to 'PENDING' (the exact draft the disclosure step completed against). amendment_hash = SHA-256 over ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 of this document with amendment_hash removed. An amendment whose disclosure phase is PENDING is NOT usable by the review engine (material amendments require the completed disclosure).

candidate_id.description: The candidate being amended (candidate identity is stable; case_version advances).

order_basis.description: The owner adjudication order clause that authorizes this amendment (e.g. 'M3-CA0-A v1 §5: uniquely correct answer establishable without outcome-dependent reasoning').

prior.description: The immutable prior version this amendment transforms.

new.description: The resulting version (deterministically derived, never hand-composed).

defect.description: §7: the exact defect, why it is a defect, and the preserved evidence.

change.description: The exact, mechanically applicable change (GT document consolidation).

retained_answer_block.description: 1-based source_block index of the INTENDED_CORRECT_ANSWER block retained.

retained_derivation_block.description: 1-based source_block index of the DERIVATION block retained.

removed_answer_blocks.description: source_block indices of the defective answer blocks removed.

removed_derivation_blocks.description: source_block indices of the defective derivation blocks removed.

not_outcome_dependent.description: §7: the stated reason the change is not outcome-dependent.

provenance.description: §7: new provenance of the amendment act itself.

disclosure_phase.description: Machine evidence of the SEPARATE two-step process (draft first, disclosure afterwards — never concurrent).

representation_bias_disclosure.description: The M3-CA0-A §7 (amended) REPRESENTATION-BIAS DISCLOSURE, completed in a separate step AFTER drafting. Audit/provenance field, never an eligibility decision; NONE/POSSIBLE/KNOWN per the T1-pilot timing semantics (NONE = no representation-related influence known or reasonably suspected at the separate disclosure step; it is NOT a self-certification of bias absence).

disclosed_against_draft_hash.description: Must equal draft_hash: the disclosure was completed against exactly this fully-formed draft.

basis.description: The honest disclosure basis (knowledge state, influence surface, why the value was chosen).

re_review.description: §8: material amendments never inherit review state; full re-review required.

draft_hash.description: Hash of the disclosure-free draft (see description). Present in every record: the disclosure step is provably post-draft.

amendment_hash.description: Hash of the completed record (present iff disclosure_phase.status = COMPLETED).
